bulletPoints: Designed and deployed a collaborative AI edge system using early-exit neural networks to reduce inference time and energy use on edge devices while maintaining target accuracy.
Developed a transformer-based exit–confidence predictor and a GNN-based system-performance estimator to jointly tune accuracy, latency, and loss for multi-device edge inference.
Developed context-aware prediction and RL-based control modules to detect environment shifts and auto-reconfigure system parameters in real time, preserving accuracy and latency.
Built an AI-driven scheduler to continuously optimize task–host placement in a fog-computing environment, reducing response time by 8% and SLA violations by 50%
Built real-time monitoring and ensemble anomaly-detection pipelines on manufacturing data to detect early quality issues in the manufacturing production line and reduced 30% cost.
Developed a transformer-based language model that provides recommendation solutions to production-line analysts, reducing issue resolution time by 20%.
Designed an OCR-based text-extraction framework to pull key values from oscilloscope images, reducing engineers’ manual data entry by 90%.
Led end-to-end design, development, and cloud deployment of SiMON, a web-based solar-field anomaly monitoring platform.
Built full-stack solution: React (frontend), Python (backend), and a MATLAB-based algorithm service containerized with Docker. Configured Nginx as a reverse proxy/load balancer.
Delivered a production-ready system that enabled [SEENG LTD](https://www.seeng-s.co.uk/) to demonstrate business value and win new funding and external contracts.
